paper_innovations.description: First observation that DiTs exhibit hierarchical blockified sparsity patterns rather than continuous patterns, achieving 0.93-1.0 Recall compared to 0.12-0.54 for continuous patterns
paper_innovations.runtime_improvement: Reduces complexity from O(L²d) to O((1-sparsity)L²d) with sparsity=0.8

paper_innovations.description: Discovery that sparse patterns and LSE distributions remain invariant across denoising steps, enabling efficient caching
paper_innovations.runtime_improvement: Enables LSE-cached search reducing online search time to <5% of full attention time

paper_innovations.description: Two-phase search mechanism: (1) Fused Online Search computes full attention and caches LSE, (2) LSE-Cached Search reuses cached data
paper_innovations.runtime_improvement: Reduces search overhead by 50% compared to naive online search

paper_innovations.description: Adjusts sparsity per-head based on individual Recall performance while maintaining average sparsity
paper_innovations.runtime_improvement: Improves quality by 0.5-1.0 PSNR without computational overhead

paper_innovations.description: Plug-and-play solution requiring no fine-tuning or dataset profiling
paper_innovations.runtime_improvement: Zero additional training cost, immediate deployment

identified_gaps.description: Method only validated on 3D Full Attention, not tested on Spatial-Temporal attention variants
Uses fixed block_size=64, may not be optimal for all video resolutions/lengths
Experiments conducted on single A100 GPU, no distributed/multi-GPU evaluation
Only tested on HunyuanVideo and CogVideoX1.5-5B, no validation on other DiT architectures
Lacks theoretical bounds on approximation error or convergence guarantees

proposed_improvements.description: Automatically adjust block size based on video resolution and sequence length
proposed_improvements.implementation: Use heuristic: block_size = min(64, max(16, sqrt(h*w)/4))
proposed_improvements.expected_runtime: Get_Time(L/B_dynamic, B_dynamic, d) where B_dynamic varies per input

proposed_improvements.description: Parallelize search across multiple GPUs using tensor parallelism
proposed_improvements.implementation: Split attention heads across GPUs, aggregate results using AllReduce
proposed_improvements.expected_runtime: Get_Time(L/B, B, d/N_GPUs) with N_GPUs speedup factor

proposed_improvements.description: Dynamically adjust sparsity during generation based on content complexity
proposed_improvements.implementation: Monitor attention entropy, increase sparsity for low-entropy regions
proposed_improvements.expected_runtime: Variable: Get_Time(L/B, B, d) with sparsity ∈ [0.7, 0.9]

proposed_improvements.description: Share sparse patterns between text-video and video-text attention matrices
Lightweight neural network to refine block patterns based on input features
proposed_improvements.implementation: Small MLP (128→64→1) per block to adjust selection probability

proposed_improvements.description: Multi-resolution search: coarse global → fine local block selection
proposed_improvements.implementation: First search at 4×4 block level, then refine within selected regions
proposed_improvements.expected_runtime: Get_Time(L/(4B), 4B, d) + Get_Time(L/B, B, d) * sparsity
